# José Alejandro Betancur Álvarez

###### He assumed the position of director of Imaginar Futuros

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Institutional Information EAFIT University](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional)
- [Institutional Communications](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales)
- [Press Releases 2026](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2026)
- José Alejandro Betancur Álvarez assumed the position of Director of Imaginar Futuros

“This new challenge for me represents the culmination of three decades at the intersection of technology and humanism, leading me to become an architect of educational futures: creating a platform where strategic foresight amplifies our capacity to design preferable futures for education and work in the region.”

José Alejandro Betancur Álvarez, Director of Imaginar Futuros.

![Image](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/31e545e7-a910-405f-973b-ab59d6901319/web/jose-alejandro-betancur-alvarez-enero-2026.png)

Dear EAFIT community,

In July 2022, we presented the Imaginar Futuros Center to society and, with this action, we began to promote conversations about trends in learning processes; readings and questions about the signs that the present showed us in relation to the demands of the future; and the construction of new dynamics to reflect on the new horizons of education.

Today we want to relaunch this unit with a new purpose: to enable Latin America to imagine, design and lead the futures of education and work.

With this unit, now part of the Strategy Department, the University seeks to generate decisive actions through the systematic detection of emerging signals and the construction of future scenarios. All of this is viewed through three lenses:

1. **Education:** focused on the evolution of pedagogical models and learning trajectories.
2. **Technology:** to address the impact on social and productive systems.
3. **And work:** focused on transformations in value-creating activities.

And, since January 13, 2026, José Alejandro Betancur Álvarez, Master in Administration and Systems Engineer from EAFIT, assumed the leadership of this unit, after being for two years (2022-2024) in charge of the Nodo Center, where he supported the training of more than 18,000 people, from different regions of the country, in matters of artificial intelligence and new technologies; designed strategic learning experiences that combine innovation, talent and real business results; and led strategic alliances with the industry to create high-impact programs.

José Alejandro is an architect of educational futures with three decades of experience at the intersection of technology and humanism, and his fields of interest include strategic foresight, digital transformation, artisanal intelligence, and the development of innovative methodologies to anticipate and design the futures of education and work.

Throughout his professional career, he has been associated with Intergrupo as chief design officer/chief innovation officer (2017-2022), mobile applications strategy manager (2010-2014) and quality manager (2005-2010); and has served as managing director of Medellín Smart Services (2016-2017); CEO and co-founder of KZ Labs (2007-2026); research manager of Choucair Testing (2004-2005); and research manager of Aleriant Inc (2001-2004).

He has also held the positions of director of the startup Grind, co-director of The Founder and co-founder of Startups Academy; and has been a teacher and mentor for companies and entrepreneurs on topics such as startup creation, continuous research of new teaching tools and support for the entrepreneurial ecosystem.

He is also the author of publications such as Vibe Coding without myths: from idea to real product in record time; Prompt error: a guide to boosting the mind and unleashing creativity with artificial intelligence; and The Art of Design Thinking.

In a world of accelerated change, Imaginar Futuros seeks to transform uncertainty into opportunities, and that is why we welcome José Alejandro to this position and wish him much success.

We are confident that, with his leadership, collective imagination will become action and the educational vision will engage with innovation, technology, and humanism to generate a tangible impact in our region.

Sincerely,

Isabel Gutiérrez Ramírez,

Director of Strategy

Press Release No. 5

Medellín, January 30, 2026

metadata.abstract: José Alejandro Betancur Álvarez asume la dirección del centro Imaginar Futuros de EAFIT, unidad que relanza su propósito para que América Latina imagine, diseñe y lidere los futuros de la educación y el trabajo. Con tres décadas de experiencia en la intersección entre tecnología y humanismo, Betancur se posiciona como un arquitecto de futuros educativos. Su mandato buscará transformar la incertidumbre en oportunidad mediante la detección de señales emergentes y la construcción de escenarios bajo los lentes de la educación, la tecnología y el trabajo, con el objetivo de generar un impacto tangible en la región.
